reason: A Feishu/Lark integration bridge that lets users control a local DeepSeek Harness coding agent through chat, with streaming cards, workspaces, parallel tasks, approvals, notifications, and session management.

summaries.zh: 将本机 DeepSeek Harness 编码代理接入飞书或 Lark，支持通过聊天使用流式卡片、项目工作区、并行任务、审批、通知和会话管理。
summaries.en: Connects a local DeepSeek Harness coding agent to Feishu or Lark, providing chat-based streaming cards, project workspaces, parallel tasks, approvals, notifications, and session management.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu/Lark for bidirectional chat messaging
Submits chat requests to a local DeepSeek Harness coding agent
Streams agent progress, tool activity, approvals, and results through Feishu cards
Creates and manages isolated project workspaces and parallel tasks
Reads received images and text files into task context
Stores and manages model-provider settings and credentials
Persists sessions, jobs, notifications, and workspace state
Can install and restart a local guardian service for the agent runtime
